title: portulaca howellii
intro: Portulaca howellii, commonly known as Howell's purslane, is a type of flowering plant in the Portulacaceae family. This succulent plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from inflammation and pain due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Portulaca howellii include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, through its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide potential therapeutic applications.
